blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style wooden armchair with a tall, panelled vertical backrest, chunky rectangular armrests, sturdy square corner legs with panelled sides, and a dark olive-brown seat cushion. The geometry is clean and continuous with stylized hand-painted wood grain and leather textures.
blind.from_above: A square footprint defined by the thick armrests and back rail framing a dark squarish seat cushion in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
